long_biography.plain_text:
Registered nursing supplied the practical foundation for Michelle Gorringe's business. In 1996, she and Stephen Pattrick started Newcross Healthcare from a small back office in Torquay, aiming to improve healthcare staffing and the delivery of care. Gorringe became co-founder and chief operating officer, helping the company expand from one branch into a nationwide workforce provider.

Newcross now combines clinical staffing, home care, complex care and professional training with digital systems. Gorringe remains a director and exercises significant control over the main operating company. As chief ethics officer, she concentrates on person-centred care, professional standards, education and recognition for care workers, keeping the perspective of a registered nurse within the group's leadership.
